structured.reason: The description contains a hedge with a conditional that points to a downside: "Consistent use may help reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles." The "may help" hedge and the "Consistent use" condition imply the product does not work without sustained effort. This responds to reviewer complaints that no improvement was seen after 10 days and that the reviewer saw no difference after years of use. This falls under category 2 (hedges pointing to a downside) and category 4 (conditional praise implying failure without special effort). Other claims, such as the soothing, collagen, and makeup-base statements, are plain positive claims and do not cause a failure on their own.
